claims.statement: Community Exchange is described as a student community in Global Campus for project exposure and finding student repositories seeking collaborators or maintainers. It is not proof of account access, project publication consent or repository trust.

Students or faculty at accredited institutions are described as able to apply for Global Campus, a portal for community, developer tools, events, Classroom, Community Exchange, Student Pack and other benefits. Application eligibility is not approval or entitlement to every offer; linked sites and pages are not reviewed by this receipt.

The fragment gives the education dashboard as the Community Exchange entry point, then separate student and teacher application links for accredited-institution applicants who have not joined. Access remains conditional on actual benefit approval and account context; external forms and linked pages were not reviewed, and no application was submitted.

The fragment recommends applying for free Team with unlimited users and private repositories in its education context. The historical offer does not prove current eligibility, approval, unrestricted resource usage or an estate plan change; linked plans and teacher-application pages are not reviewed.

The procedure navigates Education benefits settings, starts a Global Campus application, completes a form and submits it. Submission is not approval or verified entitlement; no form was completed, submitted or used to expose personal information.

The pinned teacher-benefit requirements list educator, faculty or researcher status, a verifiable school-issued email, documents proving school affiliation and a personal GitHub account. These are source eligibility criteria, not assertions about the user, completed identity verification or authority to collect or upload personal records.

Classroom assignment-repository Codespaces usage is described as charged to the classroom-owning organization rather than the student's personal allowance. This payer-scope distinction does not establish actual billing configuration, available organization quota, exemption from costs or authorization to launch resources.

The pinned benefit grants verified students personal-account Codespaces use up to 180 core hours monthly and states storage and core-hour allowance equivalence to Pro without specifying a storage quantity. Core hours are not necessarily elapsed hours. This historical statement does not verify current entitlement or apply the personal benefit to organization-paid Classroom assignments; the billing page is not reviewed.

Reapplication guidance calls for a different image from the initial application and a clearly visible date demonstrating current academic status. It does not establish acceptance, identity truth or permission to reuse or expose personal records; no image was collected or uploaded.

Reapplication proof examples are school ID, transcript or another dated document showing academic status. A visible date is not independently verified affiliation or application approval. No private document was accessed, copied, committed or submitted.
